Dave Matthews Band
July 26, 2019
Coral Sky Amphitheatre
West Palm Beach, FL

Re-air on SiriusXM from September 20, 2019.
Recorded by Allen Thompson.
Mix is a bit different, the guitar is pushed back in the mix.
With the re-air, they cut space between the songs so Stefan's solo before Watchtower is missing, etc.
